home.lens-desc-1: Learning Outcome Based Information System (LENS) is an educational methodology prioritizing measurable and meaningful learning outcomes. This platform provides comprehensive tools for curriculum management, CLO (Course Learning Outcomes) assessment, and PLO (Program Learning Outcomes) attainment evaluation.
home.lens-desc-2: The LENS system enables lecturers and study program coordinators to conduct curriculum mapping, monitor learning target attainment, and perform continuous improvement analysis. All stakeholders can monitor academic progress in real-time through dashboards aligned with national and international accreditation standards.
home.sub-apps-guide: Click on a module below to directly navigate to the sub-application matching your role.
home.service-desk: Service Desk Directorate of Information Technology Center (PUTI):
kurikulum.home-desc: Welcome to the Curriculum Management Sub-Application. This module is used to manage active curricula, PLO/CPL mapping, and course structures.
silabus.home-desc: Welcome to the Syllabus (SUB CLO & RPS) Sub-Application. This module is used for Sub-CLO management, preparation, and verification of Semester Learning Plans.
perkuliahan.home-desc: Welcome to the Lectures & Attendance Sub-Application. This module is used to manage class schedules, student attendance, and daily lecture activities.
penilaian.home-desc: Welcome to the Assessment & Evaluation Sub-Application. This module is used for grade entry, assessment weighting, and grading period configuration.
portofolio.home-desc: Welcome to the Portfolio Sub-Application. This module provides learning portfolio reports and course outcome attainment analysis.
akademik-admin.home-desc: Welcome to the Academic Administrator Sub-Application. This module is used by academic administrators to manage academic master data and system settings.
super-admin.home-desc: Welcome to the Super Admin Sub-Application. This module provides full control over system management, users, and global access permissions.
